_comment: Menstrual-cycle aware autoregulation. Multipliers are applied by the system (utils/cycle.js + writer.js), NOT by the AI. Edit freely - every athlete responds differently.

menstrual.label: Menstruation (day 1-5)
menstrual.note: Bleeding phase. Keep the movement patterns, shave the load ~10%, stop 2 reps short. Skip max-effort attempts; light training usually reduces cramps.

follicular.label: Follicular (rising estrogen)
follicular.note: Best recovery window of the cycle. Push linear progression hard here - this is where weight increases should land.

ovulatory.label: Ovulation (peak strength, joint laxity)
ovulatory.note: Peak force output - good window for PR attempts on barbell lifts. Ligament laxity is highest: strict technique, no sloppy depth, no explosive/plyo novelty.

early_luteal.label: Early luteal
early_luteal.note: Still solid capacity. Hold the progression, expect a slightly higher heart rate and perceived effort at the same weight.

late_luteal.label: Late luteal / PMS
late_luteal.note: PMS window: higher core temperature, worse recovery, lower motivation. Hold or slightly reduce the load, cut accessory volume, extend rest. Maintenance is a win here.
